caption: The drawing consists of an array of abstract, interconnected shapes primarily outlined in black and red on a textured, speckled gray background. To the left, there are cog-like and zigzag linear forms with both curved and angular segments, with one section having a sawtooth pattern in red with a black line running through it. Centrally, there is a large, irregular black form bordered in red and white, with smaller, circular and spiral details around it. The composition also features lines and squiggles interconnecting with circular, starburst, and fan shapes, all enclosed within red outlines. On the right, a thicker black form extends horizontally, ending in a fish-tail or forked shape with red striping along its border. The entire image is set within wide, off-white borders.
title: Petroglyph Design
